hit: Dear Riverbeck Borough Council, I am writing to formally request that you erase all personal data you hold about me under my right to erasure (Article 17 GDPR). My name is Marjorie Anstey, council tax account 88321-RB. Please confirm in writing once this has been completed.

Hiya — could you wipe my details off your systems please? I rang the housing team a while back and gave them loads of info and I'd rather you didn't keep any of it now. Cheers, Danny Fowler, Eltham Road.
I no longer consent to Riverbeck Borough Council holding any records about me and I'd like them disposed of. Reference for my old library membership was LB-40192 if that helps you find the lot.

To whom it may concern, please remove everything you hold about me from your files. I moved out of the borough back in March and see no reason for you to keep anything relating to me. Yours, P. Okonkwo.
Right, I want everything you've got on me gone. Name, address history, the lot. Get rid of it all. Geoffrey Halliwell, formerly of 14 Mill Lane.

Dear Sir or Madam, I should be grateful if you would arrange for the complete destruction of my personal records held by the authority. I am exercising my right to be forgotten and expect acknowledgement within the statutory month. Mrs E. Tranter.
Could you please scrub my information from your databases? I've had enough of being on your lists and I withdraw any permission for you to store my data. Many thanks — Aisha Rahman.
I'm writing to ask that you delete my account and all associated personal data from the Riverbeck parking permit portal. Username was hollis_t and I don't want any trace left, please.
Please take my personal data off your records entirely. I was on the electoral roll correspondence list and various others — I'd like all of it cleared down. Walter Beech, ref WB-2211.

Following my move abroad I would like Riverbeck Council to permanently erase all data relating to me, including any held by the benefits and revenues teams. Kindly confirm completion. Yours faithfully, S. Lindqvist.

Hello, after some thought I'd rather you didn't keep my details any longer — can you clear out whatever you've got stored about me? Don't need a copy or anything, just want it gone. Thanks, Bryony Cole.

I hereby exercise my right to erasure and require that any and all personal information concerning me, Nathaniel Frost (DOB on file), be expunged from Riverbeck Borough Council's systems without delay.
near: Dear Council, I've recently moved within the borough and need to update my address on your records. Old address was 7 Garrick Close, new one is 22 Pendle Way. Please change it across all your departments. Thanks, Linda Marsh.
Hello — you've been spelling my surname wrong on all your letters. It's 'Featherstonehaugh', not 'Fetherston'. Could you correct it on my file please? Account 55109-RB.
I'd like to make a subject access request, please. Could you send me a copy of all the personal data Riverbeck Borough Council holds about me? Happy to provide ID. Regards, Tomasz Wójcik.
Could you tell me what information you actually hold on me, and who you share it with? I'm not asking you to change anything, I just want to understand what's on file. Many thanks — Gwen Pritchard.
Please remove the old address from my record and put the new one in — I'm now at Flat 3, Cobbold House. Everything else can stay the same. Cheers, Reuben Achterberg.
Hi, my phone number on your system is out of date. Can you swap it for my new mobile, 07700 900812? Don't change anything else please. Faye Dunmore.
I'd like a copy of the housing application data I submitted last year, for my own files. Not looking to alter or remove it, just need to see what was recorded. Ref HA-7741. Thank you, M. Achebe.
Morning — I think my date of birth has been entered wrong on the council tax account (shows 1974, should be 1947). Could you amend it? Account holder: Cyril Wraith.
Could you confirm which of my contact details you have on file? I keep getting post at two different addresses and want to make sure the right one is marked as current. Thanks, Priya Nandakumar.
Writing to correct my title on your correspondence — it should be Dr, not Mr. Minor thing but it's started to grate. Please update it. Dr H. Salisbury, ref 30248.

I'd like to know what data you hold about me and where you got it from, as I've started receiving letters about services I never signed up for. Not a complaint as such, just want clarity. Owen Tregaskis.
Please update my emergency contact on the sheltered housing record — it should now be my daughter, not my late husband. Number to follow once I've checked it. Mrs Olwen Pryce.
form: Hi there, could you please take me off the Riverbeck Community News mailing list? I keep getting the monthly newsletter and I'd rather not. Ta.
Dear Council, I put up a poster on the Marsh Green community noticeboard about a lost cat — she's been found now, so could someone take it down please? Thanks ever so much.
Please can you remove the listing for the 'Riverbeck Repair Café' from the public events calendar — the venue has fallen through and we're cancelling it. Organiser: B. Stott.
I'd like to unsubscribe from the planning alerts email. I signed up ages ago and don't need them anymore. Cheers.
There's a comment I left on the council's online forum about the bin collection consultation — could a moderator delete it please? It came out ruder than I meant.
Could you take down the advert for the second-hand piano on the parish hall noticeboard? It's sold now. Thanks, the chap who put it up on Tuesday.
Please cancel and remove our stall booking from the public listing for the Riverbeck Summer Fayre — circumstances have changed and we can't attend. The Allotment Society.
Can you delete the duplicate entry for 'Friday Knit & Natter' on the library events page? It's showing twice and confusing people. Thank you.
Hello, please remove the 'Volunteers Wanted' notice from the council website — the position has been filled. Posted by the Riverbeck Litter Pickers.
I'd like the old road-closure notice for Tanner's Lane taken off your news page — the works finished weeks ago and it's misleading drivers. Ta very much.
Could you unsubscribe this address from the leisure centre promotions texts? We never asked to be added and they come at all hours.
Please take down the photo of last year's carnival from the council Facebook page that features our float — the banner has the wrong charity name on it and we'd rather it weren't up. The Rotary lot.
none: Just wanted to say a big thank you to the grounds team — the flowerbeds along the High Street have been looking absolutely lovely this spring. Made my walk to work a treat.
Dear Council, the streetlight outside number 9 Coronation Avenue has been flickering for about a week now. Thought you'd want to know. Regards, T. Aldous.
Hello, can you confirm what time the household waste centre on Bracken Road opens on a Sunday? Planning a clear-out this weekend. Thanks.
Quick note to confirm I received the recycling calendar through the door this morning — all in order, no issues. Cheers.
There's a pothole forming near the junction of Wexley Street and the bypass — getting bigger after all the rain. Might be worth a look before someone clips it. Best, R. Coen.
Could you let me know whether the Tuesday market is still going ahead during the bank holiday week? Want to plan my stall. Many thanks.
Thanks for sorting the fallen branch on the footpath so quickly after I reported it last week — much appreciated, that was a fast turnaround.
Hi, is the Riverbeck Leisure Centre pool open during half term, and are the swimming lessons running as normal? Asking for the kids. Ta.
Just to flag that the bench by the duck pond in Memorial Park has a loose slat — nothing urgent but someone might catch their coat on it. K. Probert.
Wanted to pass on how impressed we were with the new pedestrian crossing on Foundry Lane. Feels much safer getting the little ones to school now. Thank you.
Could you tell me the date of the next full council meeting and whether members of the public can sit in? Curious to come along. Regards, M. Eastwood.
Morning all — the grit bin at the top of Sheepcote Hill is empty again and we've frost forecast this week. Could someone top it up? Cheers, J. Holloway.
